recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17007 unless a later issue reopens broader canonical URL wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17007 was a Published/Persuasive, non-substantive STU3 correction against FHIR-core references section 2.3.0.5 asking to change "The canonical URI SHOULD also the location where the master copy of the artifact is found" to "The canonical URI SHOULD also be the location where the master copy of the artifact is found."
initial_application: The correction was applied by git commit a5be343a59842242366a8a82f45c91ba373d924f, subject "GF#17007 - typo", whose git-svn-id records build@14241 and matches the Jira comment "svn revision 14241."
additional_context: Later commit 6f7c3716ef8e176e5ea811ceb12844b81a3904ec (GF#18673) clarified the same canonical guidance from canonical URI to canonical URL wording and rephrased the surviving resource identity sentence to say the canonical URL SHOULD also resolve to the master-copy location. Current references.html points canonical identity readers to resource.html#canonical, while source/resource/resource-notes.xml carries the corrected active wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current source does not contain the erroneous "SHOULD also the location" wording and the current "SHOULD also resolve to" sentence is grammatical and semantically consistent with the requested correction.
